android.desc:
Guten makes it easy to discover, download, and read 70,000+ free public-domain books from Project Gutenberg on your phone. No account required. No digital clutter. Just books.

Whether you're reading Jane Austen on your commute, studying Plato with highlights and notes, or reading a chapter every night before bed, Guten gives you a clean, focused EPUB reading experience built for real readers.

Find your next great read
Browse and search the Project Gutenberg catalog by title, author, language, or subject. View covers, metadata, and book details before you download. Found a Gutenberg link in your browser? Share it directly to Guten or paste the URL or ebook number to import it instantly.

Read offline, your way
Download EPUB books over Wi-Fi or mobile data and read anywhere — no internet connection needed after download. A Wi-Fi-only download option keeps you in control on metered plans. Customize your reading experience with adjustable font size, font family, line spacing, themes (Light, Dark, Sepia, or system), and optional swipe navigation. Jump between chapters, search within the current chapter or across the whole book, zoom inline images, and always return to where you left off.

Highlight, bookmark, and take notes
Mark important passages with highlights, save bookmarks, and attach notes as you read. Long-press to look up word definitions or share quotes with full book, author, and chapter context. Bookmarks, highlights, and notes survive even if you remove the book file to save space — your reading life isn't tied to whether the EPUB is on your device.

Build a daily reading habit
Set a daily reading goal in minutes and track your progress on the home dashboard. See your current streak, longest streak, total reading time, and books completed at a glance.

Keep your library organized
Manage your downloads, sort by recently opened, title, or author, and keep important titles available offline for reference. Back up and restore your reading data — progress, bookmarks, highlights, notes, collections, and preferences — anytime with simple JSON export and restore, so you can move between devices.

Accessibility & privacy
TalkBack-friendly with labeled reader and navigation controls. Respects Android system font scaling. Your reading data stays on your device. Network requests go only to Project Gutenberg (browse and download) and Google Play (Premium billing). Crash reports are scrubbed of personal info, no book content or reading hist

quotes.text:
Hi, HN. I read about 60-100 books a year and wanted a frictionless ereader for Project Gutenberg books, so I built Guten.

Users can search the PG catalog within the app or Share a book's page from their browser to Guten for import. The app includes the usual ereader features like search, highlight, bookmarks, and notes. I like my apps privacy-focused: Guten doesn't require an account, and there are no ads or tracking.

The reading experience is totally free, but there's also a one-time premium upgrade available for extra features like TTS read-aloud and note/highlight exports.

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bhunt.guten

Would love feedback while it's still in open testing.
